note: The bot merges winners. Nothing else may write to main, including the bot's own token by accident.

rationale.required_status_checks: A submission that fails the layout check must not be mergeable at all, so a bot bug cannot merge one.
rationale.required_pull_request_reviews: null on purpose: the bot merges the winner unattended, and a required human review would deadlock every promotion.
rationale.enforce_admins: false so an operator can still perform a reviewed rollback without unprotecting the branch first.
rationale.allow_force_pushes: false: the promotion history is the audit trail.
rationale.allow_deletions: false: a deleted main is an unrecoverable lane.
